registers.name: ID
registers.description: Shared SRAM identity.

registers.name: COMMAND
registers.description: One-hot W1 pulses START=1 STOP=2 APPLY=4 CLEAR=8 SNAPSHOT=16 ADOPT_PROFILE=32 RESTORE_PROFILE=64. Full WSTRB required; invalid/busy command returns SLVERR. Reads return zero.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: bit0 armed, bit1 not quiescent, bit2 applying, bit3 fault.

registers.name: SNAPSHOT_SEQUENCE
registers.description: Increments on accepted SNAPSHOT.

registers.name: CAPABILITIES
registers.description: ABI1, fixed PHY clock, modes0..4; exact driver-supported value.

registers.name: WORDS
registers.description: Number of physical 16-bit SRAM words (512KiB).

registers.name: OWNERSHIP
registers.description: bit0 tester request, bit1 tester grant, bit2 clock_ready. Live.

registers.name: PROFILE
registers.description: bit0 profile passed, bit1 profile pending, bit2 normal timing differs from defaults.

registers.name: SHADOW_BASE_WORD
registers.description: Physical 16-bit word offset, 0..262143.

registers.name: SHADOW_COUNT_WORDS
registers.description: 1..262144 words; base+count <=262144.

registers.name: SHADOW_PATTERN_MODE
registers.description: pattern[3:0]0..8, mode[6:4]0..4, bit7 reserved0, descending8, stop_on_error9, reserved[15:10]0, seed[31:16].

registers.name: SHADOW_TIMING0
registers.description: READ,WE,SETUP,HOLD: four 8-bit slots, 1.25ns nominal slot resolution.

registers.name: SHADOW_TIMING1
registers.description: REL[7:0],ADDR[15:8] slots; upper16 reserved0.

registers.name: SHADOW_RESERVED
registers.description: Must be zero for valid config.

registers.name: SHADOW_METADATA
registers.description: Opaque metadata word (RTL does not constrain it).

registers.name: ACTIVE_CONFIG
registers.description: Eight consecutive active configuration words through0x5c, changed by accepted APPLY when quiescent.

registers.name: NORMAL_TIMINGS_LO
registers.description: Current normal-operation timing low32.

registers.name: NORMAL_TIMINGS_HI
registers.description: Current normal-operation timing high16.

registers.name: SNAPSHOT
registers.description: 64 consecutive frozen status words through0x1fc; SNAPSHOT command required. [0]status,[1]epoch,[2]work,[3]total,[4]passes,[5]completed,[6]aborts,[7]failures,[8..11]first error,[12..13]active cycles,[14..15]payload bytes,[16..17]elapsed cycles,[18]reads,[19]writes,[20]cursor,[21]host Hz,[22..29]config,[30]PHY Hz,[31]clock,[32..47]perDQ errors,[48]owner,[49..50]normal timing,[51]profile,[52..63]zero.
